articles.summary: Core & Main, Inc. (NYSE: CNM), a leading specialty distributor dedicated to advancing reliable infrastructure with local service, nationwide, today announced, in advance of its participation at the 2026 Baird Global Industrial Conference, preliminary estimated financial results for the third quarter ended November 1, 2026, an updated fiscal 2026 outlook, its third consecutive quarter of record open-market share repurchases and the completion of three acquisitions.
articles.title: Core & Main Announces Preliminary Third-Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results, Updated Fiscal 2026 Outlook, Multiple Acquisitions and Record Share Repurchases
